intent: To illustrate the proportion of electricity consumption in California attributed to indoor marijuana cultivation relative to total household usage.

units.meaning: Indoor marijuana cultivation accounts for about 9% of California household electricity consumption.
accepted_routes: Indoor marijuana cultivation accounts for 9% of California household electricity consumption.
About 9 percent of household electricity in California goes to indoor marijuana growing.
The indoor marijuana share of California household electricity use is 9%.
Indoor grow modules make up 9% of California household electricity use.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The arc must stop at about 9% of the circle, with the whole labeled as California household electricity.
units.temporal_anchor: The percentage clause: 'indoor marijuana grow modules account for about X% of household electricity use' (use table's 9%).
units.reviewer_question: Should the ground truth require the 9% in the table as the authoritative share?

units.meaning: The 9% share is relative to total household electricity consumption in California, not total electricity consumption overall.
accepted_routes: The 9% share is of household electricity consumption in California.
The denominator is California household electricity usage.
It is a share of household electricity consumption, not all electricity use.
units.visual_evidence_rule: Title, subtitle, or legend must specify California household electricity consumption as the denominator.
units.temporal_anchor: The phrase 'of household electricity use' and the opening phrase 'In California'.
units.reviewer_question: Should the ground truth require the household-electricity denominator, not all California electricity?

optional_valid: The ring remainder represents the other 91% of household electricity use.
The 9% slice is a minority of the whole.
The chart uses a part-to-whole ring form.
unsupported_to_avoid: The 12% reading taken from the ring geometry, which the narration overrides with 9%.
Causal explanations for why indoor marijuana cultivation uses electricity.
Extrapolation to total California electricity consumption or national/global shares.
Treating the denominator as all electricity consumption rather than household electricity consumption.
Interpreting relative_value 0.0900 as a percent rather than as a proportion.
Saying indoor marijuana cultivation is the largest or majority share.
notes: 旁白明确说 about 9%，环上弧长是 12%，按旁白取 9%，其余 91%。

weight_mode_note: every unit gets 1/n so coverage is a plain share; weight_template is kept for per-type analysis only
